Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed additional certification steps, and the certifying body's review took longer than the timeframe we had planned for. As a result, the project's delivery date has moved by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing work on all other components in parallel, and the certification is now in its final stage, so we do not anticipate any further delays to this timeline. We will keep you informed of progress as we approach the delivery date.

Does this revised date of 14 April still work well with your internal planning and any launch activities on your end? Please let us know if you would like to schedule a call to walk through the updated project plan in more detail.
